en: Welcome to the Pokémon League. I am Will of the Elite Four.
My Psychic-type Pokémon and I have honed our minds in every corner of the world, and the League called us here at last.
I will not lose to you. Prepare yourself!
I... can't believe it. My psychic power was not enough.
Go on to the next room. You will learn there what the Elite Four truly are.
Even having lost, I won't change my course. I'll keep training until I can see where your strength comes from.
